messages:
Nina (CSM): Quick sync 1: we got the engineering summary. Small cohort of onboarding imports were delayed by an ingestion routing bug between 09:14-09:40 PT. Affected: 5 trials, 2 paid POCs. Need coordinated customer notifications + provisional credits + reschedule help.
Ethan (CS Ops): Please list accounts and any immediate renewals at risk. I can draft two templates (trial vs paid).
Rafael (Eng): Root cause: rollout of a routing config sent ~35% of streaming ingest traffic to an older worker pool that couldn't handle KV prefix edge cases. We rolled back at 09:40 PT; requeues started at 09:45 and are 90% complete. No data exposure.
Ops Bot: Incident INC-2026-189 recorded: ingest-routing-partial-delay. Severity: P3.
Maya (Onboarding): I have two orientation sessions today. Which customers are impacted so I can prioritize who to call?
Nina (CSM): Affected list: GreenCart, Lexify, DocuStream, CodeBinder, FieldNotes (trials); LegalMate, SparkLabs (paid POCs). Prioritize LegalMate and GreenCart.
Ethan (CS Ops): Draft status note (short):
Ethan (CS Ops): "Hi <CustomerTeam>,

We experienced a brief disruption in the embeddings ingestion pipeline between 09:14-09:40 PT today that delayed some onboarding imports. Our team rolled back the change, requeued affected jobs, and is finishing validation. Most work is complete; remaining items should finish in under 2 hours.

We will follow up with an RCA and account-specific remediation. No customer data was exposed.

- Redwood CS"

Maya (Onboarding): I'll call GreenCart now and offer a make-good slot if they want.
Rafael (Eng): Postmortem draft in 48 hours; patch: add canary gating for routing config and extra requeue alerting.
Lina (Billing): For paid POCs, provisional credit up to $1,500 approved; billing will finalize amounts after CSMs confirm impact.
Ethan (CS Ops): Sending status to all affected now and including ticket refs for requeues. CSMs will handle 1:1 outreach for renewal-risk customers.
Nina (CSM): Owners: Nina -> LegalMate, GreenCart; Maya -> DocuStream, CodeBinder, FieldNotes; Ethan -> outbound notes + ticket list; Lina -> billing credits; Rafael -> eng postmortem.
Ops Bot: Requeues validated: 7/7 jobs completed at 10:02 PT. Incident status: mitigated.
Nina (CSM): Thanks team. Capture any customer feedback about unclear errors or UX problems and add it to the onboarding tracker. I'll post the sent email copy here after I send it.
Ethan (CS Ops): Sent status messages and created tickets. Pinging for reactions. :email:
